get.description: this endpoint will confirm the booking when it is paid from the mobility wallet of the user. The URL for this endpoint comes from the payment options of the booking. The booking is assigned to the organization of the wallet, `organizationID` is only used for requests from the dashboard.

parameters.description: booking id

parameters.description: balance id, which must match the current wallet balance of the user

parameters.description: initiative to assign the booking (and any related bookings) to

parameters.name: organizationID
parameters.description: organization to assign the booking (and any related bookings) to

post.description: this endpoint will confirm the booking when it is invoiced to an organization, and adds the user to that organization if needed. The URL for this endpoint comes from the payment options of the booking.

parameters.name: bookingId
parameters.description: booking id

paymentTimestamp.description: when this bundle was paid in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00[zoneID] format (ISO 8601)

paymentStatus.description: payment status, one of (pending, succeeded, canceled)

toBeAppliedTimestamp.description: when this bundle will be applied in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00[zoneID] format (ISO 8601)

appliedTimestamp.description: when this bundle was applied in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00[zoneID] format (ISO 8601)

expirationTimestamp.description: when this bundle will expire in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00[zoneID] format (ISO 8601)

pointsPerCost.description: 0 for unlimited/free, 1 by default, 0.9 for 10% discount

discountPoints.description: in cents, 500 for 5 AUD fixed discount, not included if no discount

rewardPerCost.description: 0 for none (default), 1 for 100 points per dollar, 0.1 for 10 points per dollar

symbolicRewardPerCost.description: whether the reward cost is symbolic (information for the apps, but not used to compute them) or will be used to actually compute reward points (defaults to false)

hideCost.description: whether the cost should be hidden to the user or not (defaults to false)

notificationEmail.description: if present, represents an email address to inform once a user subscribes to the corresponding bundle

offerDescription.description: if present, it specify discount description otherwise it's build from the % and $ value

method.description: When this is GET, our backend will return a payment intent, for the apps to pass to Stripe SDK (after selecting a payment option). When this is POST, apps need to POST `paymentResult.paymentMethod?.stripeId` to the `url` => Response is update URL

url.description: internal url to use this option

discountedPrice.description: price to pay (including discounts, if any)

reward.description: reward that will be used, if present

subscriptionFee.description: in cents, how much will be charged to the user every month

subscriptionDurationInDays.description: in days, how long it will last, when present.

subscriptionAutoRenew.description: whether it will auto-renew at the end of the subscription or not

currency.description: currency used for either/both subscriptionFee and minimumPurchase

transportModes.description: enabled modes with specific deals, non included ones are assumed as pay as you go

mayPurchase.description: whether it can be purchased or not

purchaseDenialReason.description: when mayPurchase is false, this will be present with an explanation for the user

description.example: Apply promo code when booking on partner's website

canRedeem.description: Indicates whether the user has enough points to redeem this reward or not

pointsRequired.description: Indicates how many points does it cost

cashbackAmount.description: if present, means this reward can be use to get credit when buying a new bundle (in cents)

approvalTimeframe.description: how much days it usually takes to be reviewed by the staff, and either approve or refuse a redemption of this reward

featured.description: whether reward is featured or not

clientSecret.description: Stripe client secret (optional), if missing, means that we don't have a payment intent and we need a payment method back

url.description: internal url to confirm the payment is done

warning.description: warning message to show to the user, if any

ActionRequired.description: present when the provider booked something different from what was requested, e.g., a different pick-up or drop-off location. The user needs to review the differences and then either confirm or cancel the booking with one of the actions.

BookingDiffReview.description: `from` and `to` are what was requested, `externalFrom` and `externalTo` are what the provider booked

internalURL.description: URL to execute the action, usually a GET request, but may require a POST request if input field is not null

input.description: if present, the internalURL requires a POST with a JSON object with a field named 'input' and a list of objects with the exact format of these ones, but having the value field completed as expected

externalURL.description: external URL to execute the action

ConfirmationConfig.description: confirmation to show to the user before executing the action
